title: CIA regressionists regress Burroughs from the Rendlesham case
place_text: New York (Sandler studio); Rendlesham Forest case

tellings.quote: I got guys I got two guys and they were CIA is regressionists that that regressed uh um Bros from the runners from forest case

plain: In the 1980s, two hypnotists tied to the CIA are said to have used regression, a method of taking someone back through buried memories under hypnosis, on John Burroughs, a witness in the Rendlesham Forest case, a well-known UFO sighting in an English forest. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells this second-hand, as something he says he has from the people involved, and links it to two men named Bob Emenegger and Allan Sandler and to Sandler's studio in New York. If true, it would mean an intelligence agency was quietly probing what a witness remembered.
